title: "Comparative Class and Ontology Heatmap"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

This interactive heatmap shows how canonical fire uses are associated with comparative fire classes and ontology terms. Each cell shows the number of canonical fire uses associated with a particular class and term.

Use the controls to switch between primary class assignments and combined primary and secondary associations. Hover over a cell to inspect the linked uses. Because a canonical fire use can have more than one ontology term, it may contribute to several columns.

[Open the figure in a separate browser tab](interactive/comparative-ontology-heatmap.html){target="_blank"}

**Skills Demonstrated:** Categorical data preparation, heatmap design, interactive controls, and R-based visualization.
